skill.summary: Guides users through configuring OpenClaw, Nginx, and GitHub Actions to establish a secure, autonomous GitHub integration pipeline.

latestVersion.changelog: Added Phase 6: Session Grouping — derive sessionKey from issue/PR number in GitHub Action to group related events. Includes config guidance for allowRequestSessionKey and allowedSessionKeyPrefixes. Note: session persistence affected by upstream bug in OpenClaw ≤ 2026.04.05.
